headline: Resolve local references against the actual document base

items.title: Resolve local references against the actual document base
items.insight: A relative base currently resolves to the document directory in the local reference gate. The browser requests a different file. Native URL resolution and differential fixtures can prevent a false passing build.
items.evidence: Native URL differential cases and a real browser agree for relative/root/query/encoded bases. Missing browser target fails even when the former validator target exists. Existing self-tests and all tracked pages pass.
